name: MU_Carnegie_FAO_Extract
description: Extracts undergraduate applicant/admit/enroll + financial aid data for Carnegie Yield Modeling / FAO. Scope: all applicants for the target fall term (enrolling and non-enrolling). Delivers a dated CSV to Carnegie SFTP. targetTerm parameter drives all term-derived logic.

parameters.name: targetTerm
parameters.label: Target Term
parameters.description: Colleague term code for the cohort (e.g. 2026FA). Drives applicant filter, ISIR import year, retention prior-year term, and FA academic-year floor.

parameters.name: carnegieSftpKey
parameters.label: Carnegie SFTP Private Key
parameters.description: OpenSSH private key for the Carnegie SFTP endpoint.

parameters.name: carnegieSftpPath
parameters.label: Carnegie SFTP Directory
parameters.description: Remote destination directory; the dated filename is appended automatically.

config.selectQuery:
WITH

applicants AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (app.appl_applicant)
        app.applications_id,
        app.appl_applicant          AS person_id,
        app.appl_acad_program       AS apply_program,
        app.appl_start_term,
        app.appl_student_type,
        app.appl_admit_status       AS admit_type,
        app.appl_source             AS first_source,
        app.appl_intg_appl_type     AS application_type,
        app.appl_date               AS application_date,
        app.applications_adddate,
        app.appl_admit_institution  AS admit_institution_id,
        oa.app_eps_code             AS eps_code,
        app.appl_rating             AS appl_rating,
        app.appl_calc_rating        AS appl_calc_rating,
        app.appl_student_load_intent AS student_load_intent,
        app.appl_residency_status   AS residency_status
    FROM dbo.applications app
    LEFT JOIN dbo.ods_applicants oa
        ON oa.applicants_id = app.appl_applicant
    WHERE app.appl_start_term = '{{context.targetTerm}}'
      AND app.appl_admit_status NOT IN ('GR')
    ORDER BY app.appl_applicant, app.appl_date DESC NULLS LAST
),

status_ac AS (
    SELECT s.applications_id,
           MIN(s.appl_status_date) AS admit_date
    FROM dbo.appl_statuses s
    WHERE s.appl_status = 'AC'
    GROUP BY s.applications_id
),

status_dp AS (
    SELECT s.applications_id,
           MIN(s.appl_status_date) AS deposit_date
    FROM dbo.appl_statuses s
    WHERE s.appl_status = 'DP'
    GROUP BY s.applications_id
),

status_wd AS (
    SELECT s.applications_id,
           MIN(s.appl_status_date) AS withdraw_date
    FROM dbo.appl_statuses s
    WHERE s.appl_status = 'WD'
    GROUP BY s.applications_id
),

latest_status AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (applications_id)
        applications_id,
        appl_status,
        appl_status_date
    FROM dbo.appl_statuses
    ORDER BY applications_id, appl_status_date DESC NULLS LAST
),

person AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.first_name,
        p.last_name,
        p.middle_name,
        p.gender,
        p.ethnic_desc,
        p.person_ethnic_1,
        p.preferred_email_address,
        p.fper_alien_status,
        p.residence_state
    FROM dbo.ods_person p
),

alt_id AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pa.id)
        pa.id             AS person_id,
        pa.person_alt_ids AS leg_id
    FROM dbo.person_alt pa
    WHERE pa.person_alt_id_types = 'LEG'
    ORDER BY pa.id, pa.pos ASC
),

address AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pai.id)
        pai.id            AS person_id,
        a.address_line_1,
        a.address_line_2,
        a.city,
        a.state,
        a.zip,
        a.country
    FROM dbo.ods_person_address_info pai
    JOIN dbo.ods_address a
        ON a.address_id = pai.person_addresses
    ORDER BY pai.id ASC, pai.pos ASC
),

enrolled AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT students_id AS person_id
    FROM dbo.ods_students
),

student_term AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (st.sttr_student)
        st.sttr_student        AS person_id,
        st.sttr_student_load   AS ft_pt,
        st.sttr_current_status AS housing_status
    FROM dbo.ods_student_terms st
    WHERE st.sttr_term = '{{context.targetTerm}}'
    ORDER BY st.sttr_student, st.sttr_term DESC NULLS LAST
),

enroll_program AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (sp.stpr_student)
        sp.stpr_student      AS person_id,
        sp.stpr_acad_program AS enroll_program
    FROM dbo.ods_student_programs sp
    ORDER BY sp.stpr_student, sp.end_date DESC NULLS LAST
),

retention AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        st1.sttr_student AS person_id,
        1                AS retained
    FROM dbo.ods_student_terms st1
    JOIN dbo.ods_student_terms st2
        ON st2.sttr_student = st1.sttr_student
        AND st2.academic_year::integer = st1.academic_year::integer + 1
    WHERE st1.sttr_term = (LEFT('{{context.targetTerm}}', 4)::integer - 1)::text || RIGHT('{{context.targetTerm}}', 2)
),

high_school AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (ia.insta_person_id)
        ia.insta_person_id AS person_id,
        ia.insta_ext_gpa   AS hs_gpa,
        ia.end_year        AS hs_grad_year
    FROM dbo.ods_institutions_attend ia
    WHERE ia.insta_grad_type ILIKE '%H%'
    ORDER BY ia.insta_person_id, ia.end_date DESC NULLS LAST
),

isir AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.ifaf_student_id)
        f.ifaf_student_id       AS person_id,
        f.ifaf_trans_receipt_dt AS fafsa_date,
        f.icres_pri_efc         AS fm_efc_sai
    FROM dbo.ods_isir_fafsa f
    WHERE f.isir_demo_import_year = RIGHT(LEFT('{{context.targetTerm}}', 4), 2)
    ORDER BY f.ifaf_student_id, f.isir_fafsa_adddate DESC NULLS LAST
),

housing AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (fs.sa_student_id)
        fs.sa_student_id            AS person_id,
        fs.sa_term_hsg              AS housing_code,
        fs.term_housing_status_desc AS housing_desc
    FROM dbo.ods_fa_status_for_term fs
    WHERE fs.sa_terms = '{{context.targetTerm}}'
    ORDER BY fs.sa_student_id, fs.compound_id
),

fa_status AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (yfa.cs_student_id)
        yfa.cs_student_id         AS person_id,
        yfa.cs_std_total_expenses AS total_coa
    FROM dbo.ods_yearly_fa_info yfa
    WHERE yfa.academic_year::integer >= LEFT('{{context.targetTerm}}', 4)::integer
    ORDER BY yfa.cs_student_id, yfa.academic_year DESC NULLS LAST
),

fa_awards AS (
    SELECT
        ta.ta_student_id                                                                               AS person_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_type_desc = 'Institutional'
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS total_institutional_aid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_category_desc = 'Merit Scholarship'
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS merit_aid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_category_desc = 'Institutional Scholarship'
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS need_aid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_type_desc = 'Institutional'
                 AND ta.award_category_desc NOT IN ('Merit Scholarship', 'Institutional Scholarship')
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS other_inst_aid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_category_desc = 'Federal PELL Grant'
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS federal_grants,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_type_desc = 'State'
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS state_grants,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_category_desc = 'Federal Work Study'
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS federal_work_study,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_category_desc = 'Federal Subsidized Loans'
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS federal_sub_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.award_category_desc = 'Federal Unsubsidized Loans'
                 THEN ta.ta_term_amount ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS federal_unsub_loans
    FROM dbo.ods_fa_term_awards ta
    WHERE ta.academic_year::integer >= LEFT('{{context.targetTerm}}', 4)::integer
      AND ta.award_action_category_desc IN ('Accepted', 'Pending')
    GROUP BY ta.ta_student_id
),

resident AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ra.rmas_person_id AS person_id
    FROM dbo.ods_room_assignments ra
    WHERE ra.rmas_term = '{{context.targetTerm}}'
      AND (ra.current_assign_status_desc IS NULL
           OR (ra.current_assign_status_desc NOT ILIKE '%cancel%'
               AND ra.current_assign_status_desc NOT ILIKE '%terminat%'))
)

SELECT
    app.person_id                                               AS "SIS_ID",
    alt.leg_id                                                  AS "LEG_ID",
    addr.address_line_1                                         AS "Address_1",
    addr.address_line_2                                         AS "Address_2",
    addr.city                                                   AS "City",
    addr.state                                                  AS "State",
    addr.zip                                                    AS "Zip",
    addr.country                                                AS "Country",
    CASE WHEN app.residency_status = 'INTL' THEN 1
         WHEN p.fper_alien_status IS NOT NULL THEN 1
         ELSE 0 END                                             AS "International_Flag",
    p.gender                                                    AS "Gender",
    CASE p.person_ethnic_1
        WHEN 'HIS' THEN 'Hispanic or Latino'
        WHEN 'NHS' THEN 'Non-Hispanic'
        ELSE COALESCE(p.ethnic_desc, p.person_ethnic_1)
    END                                                         AS "Ethnicity",
    app.eps_code                                                AS "EPS_Code",
    app.first_source                                            AS "First_Source",
    NULL                                                        AS "First_Source_Date",
    app.application_type                                        AS "Application_Type",
    CASE WHEN ls.appl_status IN ('AC', 'DP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Application_Complete_Flag",
    hs.hs_gpa                                                   AS "HS_GPA",
    NULL                                                        AS "College_GPA",
    NULL                                                        AS "Faculty_Staff_Child",
    CASE hs_inst.inst_type
        WHEN 'HS' THEN 'Public'
        WHEN 'PR' THEN 'Private'
        WHEN 'PB' THEN 'Public'
        WHEN 'CC' THEN 'Community College'
        WHEN 'HO' THEN 'Home School'
        ELSE hs_inst.inst_type
    END                                                         AS "High_School_Type",
    hs_person.preferred_name                                    AS "High_School_Name",
    hs.hs_grad_year                                             AS "High_School_Grad_Year",
    hs_inst.inst_ceeb                                           AS "High_School_CEEB",
    NULL                                                        AS "Athlete_Status",
    NULL                                                        AS "ROTC_Flag",
    NULL                                                        AS "Special_Recruit",
    NULL                                                        AS "Legacy_Status",
    NULL                                                        AS "Campus_Visit_Flag",
    NULL                                                        AS "Campus_Visit_Date",
    NULL                                                        AS "Campus_Tour_Flag",
    NULL                                                        AS "Campus_Tour_Date",
    NULL                                                        AS "Information_Session_Flag",
    NULL                                                        AS "Information_Session_Date",
    NULL                                                        AS "Open_House_Flag",
    NULL                                                        AS "Open_House_Date",
    NULL                                                        AS "Orientation_Event_Flag",
    NULL                                                        AS "Orientation_Event_Date",
    NULL                                                        AS "Virtual_Event_Flag",
    NULL                                                        AS "Virtual_Event_Date",
    NULL                                                        AS "ACT_Composite",
    NULL                                                        AS "ACT_English",
    NULL                                                        AS "ACT_Math",
    NULL                                                        AS "ACT_Reading",
    NULL                                                        AS "ACT_Science",
    NULL                                                        AS "ACT_Writing",
    NULL                                                        AS "ACT_official",
    NULL                                                        AS "ACT_multiple_scores",
    NULL                                                        AS "SAT_R_Combined",
    NULL                                                        AS "SAT_R_Math",
    NULL                                                        AS "SAT_R_ERW",
    NULL                                                        AS "SAT_official",
    NULL                                                        AS "SAT_multiple_scores",
    NULL                                                        AS "Application by Rank Round",
    NULL                                                        AS "Application by Rank Submitted Date",
    LEFT(app.appl_start_term, 4)                                AS "Enroll_Year",
    RIGHT(app.appl_start_term, 2)                               AS "Enroll_Term",
    CASE WHEN ac.admit_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END       AS "Admit_Flag",
    ac.admit_date                                               AS "Admit_Date",
    CASE WHEN dp.deposit_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END     AS "Deposit_Flag",
    dp.deposit_date                                             AS "Deposit_Date",
    CASE WHEN en.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END        AS "Enroll_Flag",
    NULL                                                        AS "Enroll_Date",
    CASE WHEN wd.withdraw_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END    AS "Deposit_Withdraw_Flag",
    wd.withdraw_date                                            AS "Deposit_Withdraw_Date",
    CASE app.admit_type
        WHEN 'FR'    THEN 'Freshman'
        WHEN 'TR'    THEN 'Transfer'
        WHEN 'GR'    THEN 'Graduate'
        WHEN 'RE'    THEN 'Re-entry'
        WHEN 'ND'    THEN 'Non-Degree'
        WHEN 'BA2ND' THEN 'Second Bachelor''s'
        WHEN 'POSTB' THEN 'Post-Baccalaureate'
        WHEN 'TS'    THEN 'Transient'
        ELSE app.admit_type
    END                                                         AS "Admit_Type",
    app.apply_program                                           AS "Apply_Program",
    NULL                                                        AS "Admit_Program",
    ep.enroll_program                                           AS "Enroll_Program",
    CASE
        WHEN app.student_load_intent = 'F' THEN 'FT'
        WHEN app.student_load_intent = 'P' THEN 'PT'
        WHEN st.ft_pt IS NOT NULL AND st.ft_pt ILIKE '%F%' THEN 'FT'
        WHEN st.ft_pt IS NOT NULL THEN 'PT'
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                         AS "FT_PT",
    CASE WHEN app.appl_student_type = 'TR' OR app.admit_type = 'TR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Transfer_Flag",
    CASE WHEN en.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ret.retained, 0) ELSE NULL END   AS "Retention_Flag",
    CASE WHEN res.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END       AS "Resident_Status",
    CASE app.residency_status
        WHEN 'INST' THEN 'In-State'
        WHEN 'OUST' THEN 'Out-of-State'
        WHEN 'INTL' THEN 'International'
        ELSE app.residency_status
    END                                                         AS "Residency_Status",
    NULL                                                        AS "Honors_Flag",
    COALESCE(app.appl_calc_rating, app.appl_rating)             AS "Admission_Rating",
    NULL                                                        AS "Other Indicators",
    isir.fafsa_date                                             AS "FAFSA_date",
    NULL                                                        AS "CSS_date",
    CASE WHEN isir.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END      AS "FAFSA_filed",
    NULL                                                        AS "Profile_filed",
    fas.total_coa                                               AS "Total_Cost_of_Attendance",
    NULL                                                        AS "Direct_Cost_of_Attendance",
    NULL                                                        AS "Tuition",
    NULL                                                        AS "Required Fees",
    NULL                                                        AS "Housing & Food",
    isir.fm_efc_sai                                             AS "FM_EFC_SAI",
    NULL                                                        AS "IM_EFC_SAI",
    fa.total_institutional_aid                                  AS "Total_Institutional_Aid",
    fa.need_aid                                                 AS "Need_Aid",
    fa.merit_aid                                                AS "Merit_Aid",
    fa.other_inst_aid                                           AS "Other_Inst_aid",
    fa.federal_grants                                           AS "Federal_Grants",
    fa.state_grants                                             AS "State_Grants",
    fa.federal_work_study                                       AS "Federal_Work_Study",
    fa.federal_sub_loans                                        AS "Federal_Sub_Loans",
    fa.federal_unsub_loans                                      AS "Federal_Unsub_Loans"

FROM applicants app
LEFT JOIN person p
    ON p.id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN address addr
    ON addr.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN status_ac ac
    ON ac.applications_id = app.applications_id
LEFT JOIN status_dp dp
    ON dp.applications_id = app.applications_id
LEFT JOIN status_wd wd
    ON wd.applications_id = app.applications_id
LEFT JOIN latest_status ls
    ON ls.applications_id = app.applications_id
LEFT JOIN enrolled en
    ON en.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN student_term st
    ON st.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN enroll_program ep
    ON ep.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN retention ret
    ON ret.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN high_school hs
    ON hs.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.institutions hs_inst
    ON hs_inst.institutions_id = app.admit_institution_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.ods_person hs_person
    ON hs_person.id = app.admit_institution_id
LEFT JOIN isir
    ON isir.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN fa_status fas
    ON fas.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN housing h
    ON h.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN alt_id alt
    ON alt.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN resident res
    ON res.person_id = app.person_id
LEFT JOIN fa_awards fa
    ON fa.person_id = app.person_id

ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name
